response: Saved Views is available today for every customer on a paid plan. This new feature lets you capture the exact filters, sorts, and groupings you use most, so you can jump straight into the work that matters without rebuilding your setup each time. Saved Views is included in all paid plans, and each user can save up to 50 views, giving you plenty of room to organize by project, sprint, priority, or any workflow that fits your team. Once you have created a view, you can share it with your team so everyone works from the same layout instead of recreating filters on their own. Whether you are a manager tracking overdue tasks, a designer following a specific sprint, or a lead reviewing progress across several projects, Saved Views keeps everything organized and easy to find. It is a small change that adds up to real time savings across your whole team, starting right now. Open any list and select Save view to get started.
